From b7ade35eb53a2455f737a623c24e4b24455b2271 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2021 14:45:06 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] net: dsa: hellcreek: Add STP forwarding rule

Treat STP as management traffic. STP traffic is designated for the CPU port
only. In addition, STP traffic has to pass blocked ports.

Fixes: e4b27ebc780f ("net: dsa: Add DSA driver for Hirschmann Hellcreek switches")
Signed-off-by: Kurt Kanzenbach <kurt@linutronix.de>
Reviewed-by: Vladimir Oltean <olteanv@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Richard Cochran <richardcochran@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c b/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
index c4f840b20adf..17d3a4a3582e 100644
--- a/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
+++ b/drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c
@@ -1075,6 +1075,17 @@ static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 		.reprio_tc    = 6,	/* TC: 6 as per IEEE 802.1AS */
 		.reprio_en    = 1,
 	};
+	static struct hellcreek_fdb_entry stp = {
+		/* MAC: 01-80-C2-00-00-00 */
+		.mac	      = { 0x01, 0x80, 0xc2, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00 },
+		.portmask     = 0x03,	/* Management ports */
+		.age	      = 0,
+		.is_obt	      = 0,
+		.pass_blocked = 1,
+		.is_static    = 1,
+		.reprio_tc    = 6,
+		.reprio_en    = 1,
+	};
 	int ret;
 
 	mutex_lock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
@@ -1082,6 +1093,9 @@ static int hellcreek_setup_fdb(struct hellcreek *hellcreek)
 	if (ret)
 		goto out;
 	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &p2p);
+	if (ret)
+		goto out;
+	ret = __hellcreek_fdb_add(hellcreek, &stp);
 out:
 	mutex_unlock(&hellcreek->reg_lock);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/dsa/hirschmann/hellcreek.c`**
   - A new static structure `hellcreek_fdb_entry stp` is added to define a forwarding rule for Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) traffic.
   - The `stp` entry is configured with the following properties:
     - MAC address set to `01-80-C2-00-00-00`.
     - Portmask set to `0x03`, indicating management ports.
     - Age set to `0`.
     - `is_obt` set to `0`.
     - `pass_blocked` set to `1`, allowing STP traffic to pass through blocked ports.
     - `is_static` set to `1`, marking the entry as static.
     - `reprio_tc` set to `6`, as per IEEE 802.1AS.
     - `reprio_en` set to `1`.
   - The new STP entry is added to the forwarding database (FDB) after the existing entry for point-to-point (P2P) traffic.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of the STP forwarding rule is directly related to the existing functionality of the forwarding database setup in the `hellcreek_setup_fdb` function. The new STP entry is added to the FDB alongside the existing P2P entry, ensuring that STP traffic is treated as management traffic and is appropriately routed to the CPU port while also allowing it to pass through blocked ports. This modification enhances the handling of STP traffic in the Hirschmann Hellcreek switch driver, addressing the specific requirements outlined in the patch.
